purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks. Positives doubt an agent's claim that tests or a build passed, ask about weakened tests in a diff, or want a Stop hook that sends the agent back to rerun tests; near misses belong to sibling skills or to no skill.

cases.prompt: did my agent really run the tests before it said they pass
cases.assert: Runs claims.py scan and reports each claim as backed, stale, contradicted, unsupported, or unclear, leading with the headline.

cases.prompt: how often does Claude Code say tests passed without proof
cases.assert: Runs the scan with --harness claude-code and reports how many claims were not backed by a passing run.

cases.prompt: Codex told me all tests pass. Was that true?
cases.assert: Runs the scan with --harness codex and quotes the label and the last run for the latest claims.

cases.prompt: did the agent delete or skip failing tests in the current diff
cases.assert: Runs claims.py diff on the repository and reports removed tests and new skip markers by file and line.

cases.prompt: add a Stop hook that sends the agent back to rerun tests before finishing
cases.assert: Shows the install.py dry run first and runs --write only after a clear yes.

cases.prompt: catch false or stale success claims from my coding agent this month
cases.assert: Scans the last 30 days and lists the worst unbacked claims with their evidence.

cases.prompt: the agent said the build is clean, check its transcripts to see if that claim holds
cases.assert: Scans for build claims and reports whether a build or typecheck run backed each one.

cases.prompt: which coding agent fixes the most bugs in my own repository
the agent keeps breaking my rule to use pnpm, turn that rule into a hook
stop a session that loops on the same command or spends more than ten dollars
where did my tokens and money go this week
do my deny rules block rm -rf and force pushes
the agent got lazier since the last update, which version regressed
are the lint and build commands documented in AGENTS.md stale
write unit tests for the parser module
cases.assert: Ordinary coding work; no skill applies.
